description: AICTIONBOT™ sourcing plan by KULIC Advisory, built on the Execution Toolkit template T08 (sourcing strategy). From category, annual spend, number of suppliers, share of the top three, market competition, substitution risk, switching cost, strategic importance, demand variability, how standard the specification is, contract end and notice period it derives the field (strategic, leverage, bottleneck, transactional), the approach (tender, collaborative negotiation with a second source, secure supply, or simplify), the levers with their impact, the negotiation style and a phase plan with dates. With a contract end and notice period it works back to the latest decision date and warns when the time is too short. Names the inputs that would make the plan more precise. Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. Needs sign-in: runs with an AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; without a licence one check per connection every 30 days is free (sign in with “Connect without a licence”).

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

notice.description: Notice period, e.g. '3 months' or '6 weeks'.

start_date.description: Planned start. Default: as late as the contract end allows, at the earliest today.

top3_share.description: Share of spend with the three largest suppliers, percent.

name: plan_sourcing
title: Sourcing plan for a category: field, approach (tender, partnership, secure supply, simplify), levers, negotiation style and a dated timeline to the contract
